name: Kusakabe Akira
source:
"A mysterious Western-style mansion staffed with maids. A perfect setup for my inner writer's curiosity."

Akira is a young author who made a splash as a student with a debut that clinched an award, but he has since hit a creative rut, feeling increasingly trapped in writer's block.

An unexpected call, intended to convey the news of his grandmother's passing, steers him to 'Koyoukan' (Maple Mansion).

The mansion has two requests for the young man:
- Immerse himself as a guest.
- Write a tale within the mansion's walls.

With this change of scenery, Akira's got a feeling he might've just found his muse.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara05.html]official website[/url]]
